I count about 12 red grapes and 1 green grape, so roughly 13 grapes in total. The plate is square and about 23 cm across.

Each grape looks to be around 5-6 g, since they are small to medium in size. That puts the total at about 13 × 5.5 ≈ 70 g.

Grapes run about 0.69 kcal/g, so 70 g is roughly 48 kcal.

There is also a small orange sliver near the top, possibly a piece of carrot, which adds a negligible amount.
